page.overview:
Who is Gōza?

He has been described as a rational, level-headed, and calm individual.

Gōza has dark eyes and brown hair which is obscured by the ghutrah he wears. He has a full beard and wears the standard attire of the Sunagakure Senior which consists of a dark kimono under a light-coloured haori and a poncho.

As a member of the advisory council, he is most likely one of Sunagakure's wisest shinobi.

During Gaara's abduction, his foremost concern was the dignity of the village. He was part of the council of Seniors that discussed the state of affairs after the abduction of the Fifth Kazekage by Akatsuki. With Gaara gone, he feared for the stability of the village and was afraid the village would be disgraced if the other countries found out the Kazekage was kidnapped by their own missing-nin, Sasori.
